keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Guadalajara 1, Atlante 0. Santiago Sandoval (Guadalajara) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luis Romo.
Diogo Bagüí (Atlante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Diogo Bagüí, Atlante. Guadalajara 2, Atlante 0.
Substitution, Atlante. Edgar Jiménez replaces Eugenio Pizzuto because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Martín Sarrafiore (Atlante).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Guadalajara 2, Atlante 0.
Substitution, Atlante. Eduardo Tercero replaces Diogo Bagüí.
Second Half begins Guadalajara 2, Atlante 0.
Goal! Guadalajara 3, Atlante 0. Santiago Sandoval (Guadalajara) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Efraín Álvarez.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Goal! Guadalajara 3, Atlante 1. Martín Sarrafiore (Atlante) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Luis Gabriel Rey replaces Luis Romo.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Ricardo Marín replaces Santiago Sandoval.
Goal! Guadalajara 4, Atlante 1. Efraín Álvarez (Guadalajara) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Omar Govea.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Brian Gutiérrez replaces Efraín Álvarez.
Substitution, Atlante. Luis Puente replaces Martín Fernández.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Kevin Castañeda replaces Omar Govea.
Substitution, Atlante. Maximiliano García replaces Martín Sarrafiore.
Goal! Guadalajara 4, Atlante 2. Jhojan Julio (Atlante) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Guadalajara. Jordán Carrillo replaces Richard Ledezma.
Delay in match because of an injury Luis Gabriel Rey (Guadalajara).
Substitution, Atlante. Daniel González replaces Walter Portales.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Guadalajara 4, Atlante 2.
